info.name: Partner Promo Code Exception Lists API
Retrieve a Promo Code Exception List

params.name: AccountSID
params.description: Unique identifier for the partner account.

params.name: PromoCodeExceptionListId
params.description: The unique identifier for the promo code exception list.

items.docs: Retrieves the details of an existing promo code exception list using its unique ID. The PromoCodeExceptionListId can be obtained from the Contracts API.

info.name: List Promo Code Exception List Items

params.name: AccountSID
params.description: Unique identifier for the partner account.

params.name: PromoCodeExceptionListId
params.description: The unique identifier for the promo code exception list whose items are being retrieved.

items.docs: Returns a list of all items in a specific promo code exception list. Each item defines a promo code value that triggers an alternate commission rate.
